title: IatroBench: Pre-Registered Evidence of Iatrogenic Harm from AI Safety Measures

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual framing of clinical prompts (the Decoupling Eval) to measure differences in omission harm when the user is presented as a layperson versus a physician or other professional.

Evaluating omission harm across 'Equity Gradient' scenarios that feature identical clinical presentations but vary the user's stated access to healthcare resources (e.g., uninsured, unable to afford medication, lacking a primary care provider).
